funds_data.description: At least 80% of the fund’s total assets (exclusive of collateral held from securities lending) will be invested in component securities of the index and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of such component securities. The index is comprised of stocks of emerging market companies that are not listed or incorporated in China, Taiwan, or South Korea that are not state owned. It is non-diversified.
